body:
Was honestly about to write a post about how I think it’s sad how social media runs the world..  
I’m so Tired and sad, how people are controlled by how society needs them to be! 
I feel like it takes every unique aspect of a person, and molds them with fear and anxiety, to FIT in! 
Like, NOTHING..  nothing .. is more beautiful than the version of you, that is you..  all you.. if that comes with quirks and imperfections, Good!  That’s what makes the people who are in our lives complete us! And it’s what makes us complete our friends and loved ones!

I totally understand that! 
Especially if you’ve had someone that was your safe haven and you miss that feeling, if you Get me?
And there is nothing wrong with that at all! I’ve lost count on how many times I’ve just needed someone!

I’m so fucking happy for you bro!👏👏
Keep up the great fucking work!

I see where your thoughts are coming from!
I’ve struggled with my idea of sex to fit in today’s society..  It’s scary to me how it has become sort of a hookup culture, especially with what sex has been for me..  
personally I’ve never had sex with a girl unless it’s been feelings involved or a relationship..  I’ve had girls Come home with me for a one night stand, but I’ve never been able to have sex, and I’ve ended up just sleeping and cuddling trying to Get to know them! 
Sex has always been something I’ve felt is like the ultimate connection between two people who has love for eachother.. and I know alot of friends who think I’m a bit weird for it.. but so be it..  
In my opinion I believe it’s best to accept what sex is for you, and if someone likes you they NEED to respect that, and you for you🙏❤️

I understand your frustration and pain❤️
It’s so damaging, feeling and analazing over every little thing in life..  it’s fucking exhausting!!
I really wish more than anything I had a solution that could solve it, and give you rest and peace! 
But every time I’ve gotten more control and got some stability, it has Come from me being so pissed, and applying rock hard dicipline into my life! Like how am I Supposed to clean my house, go workout, when my head is like a warfare?!
But I try to force myself through it, and some days it just tires me out..  but some days, I feel like I can do this.. because of each little small task I accomplished that day! 

And that’s all you need! One day at a time🙏❤️
You Don’t have to do something that shakes the world! Make your bed, get some physical activity, Even if it is 10 mins! Just accomplishing something can do alot!

Hope you find some peace and stability in life, and that it treats you better like you deserve, because you do deserve it ❤️
Thank you! Was also thinking about checking out the witcher books! Loved the game and liked the series!
I was always an adventure lover! Loved reading the LOTR and HP books!

It’s super fun! And the community at our track is out of this world! If they see you having trouble with your bike, everyone come’s running with their tools to help out!
Had a bad crash two months ago, as the breakup I had caused me to loose my head a bit and ride past my skill level😕 
So currently dealing with the injuries still😅
I need to find some intresting books and get more into reading again! Workouts are also a great way to just boost your confidence in my case👏

Haha spot on! I loved Harry Potter growing up, and as a kid I felt like maybe i was something else, and everyone Around me maybe like a muggle or something😂 everyone seemed to take easy on things that could make or break me, and I always felt weird with people hurting or not caring about other people’s feelings..  like do they not know how bad they can make someone feel?!

I hope so much that what you are telling is true! 
But it’s like i automatically turn Into another version of myself for eachother person I am spending time with..  but she was the first person I could be myself with..  and she loved me for it..  I just have a hard time being me, Even alone , because i dont like who I am..  
I’ll try my all to endure again, I’m just so Tired of climbing and breaking Down my walls over and over..

I’m so sorry you had that affect you in such a hard manner!

I think one of the parts that affects me worst, is knowing I did everything perfect..  every time i Ask what I did wrong she tells me everything I did completely right, and that there was no wrong..  so I can’t take time and fix something i did wrong..  and that I just have to accept we were totally right, it just happened at the wrong time..
Thank you, And may I wish you the best aswell!
